Observe locating, handling and station handoffs without guessing undisclosed tolerances.

guides.title: 由公開里程碑建立工程證據鏈
guides.titleEn: Build an engineering evidence chain from public milestones
guides.concept: 原型出廠、首次飛行與量產是不同的證據階段。公開研製史可以練習系統工程追溯，不能推導未公開性能或製造細節。
guides.conceptEn: Prototype rollout, first flight and production are different evidence stages. Public history supports traceability exercises, not inference of undisclosed performance or manufacturing details.
procedure: 從漢翔經國號頁面摘錄事件名稱與日期，各自保留來源位置。
把事件分類為組裝完成、功能展示或生產里程碑；分類屬教學判讀。
為每一類寫出它能證明與不能證明的事項，例如首飛不等於所有可靠度驗證完成。
用原創時間軸連結事件，未知試驗項目明確留白。
procedureEn: Record event names and dates from the AIDC IDF page with source locations.
Classify assembly completion, functional demonstration and production milestones as a teaching interpretation.
State what each can and cannot establish; first flight does not prove every reliability test.
Draw an original timeline and leave undisclosed tests unknown.
evidence: 事件、日期、來源的對照表。
至少兩項沒有被公開事件充分支持的主張。
evidenceEn: A table linking events, dates and sources.
At least two claims not established by the public events.
pitfalls: 把單一成功展示當作整套工程取證完成。
由照片比例反推敏感或未公開結構參數。
pitfallsEn: Treating one demonstration as complete qualification.
Inferring sensitive or undisclosed dimensions from image proportions.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.

guides.title: 航空零件：如何選量測與檢查方法
guides.titleEn: Aircraft parts: choosing measurement and inspection methods
guides.concept: 尺寸量測和缺陷檢測回答不同問題。漢翔公開品質頁列出的三次元量測、雷射追蹤與無損檢測可作為分類素材。
guides.conceptEn: Dimensional metrology and defect detection answer different questions. AIDC publicly lists coordinate measurement, laser tracking and nondestructive inspection as useful classification examples.
procedure: 畫一個非飛行用途的簡化接頭，標出孔位、外形與假想內部缺陷。
把每個問題寫成可觀察量：孔中心位置、形狀誤差或缺陷指示。
依官方公開方法建立候選量測表，不填入不存在的設備解析度。
解釋為何尺寸合格仍不足以排除內部缺陷，列出尚缺的檢驗依據。
procedureEn: Draw a nonflying conceptual joint with holes, shape and hypothetical internal flaws.
Express each question as an observable: hole center, form error or flaw indication.
Map candidates from the publicly listed methods without inventing instrument resolution.
Explain why dimensional acceptance does not exclude internal damage and list missing evidence.
evidence: 幾何問題、材料缺陷與候選工具的三欄表。
量測基準、尺度與未知能力的紀錄。
evidenceEn: A table separating geometry, material flaws and candidate tools.
Records of datums, scale and unknown capabilities.
pitfalls: 把沒有檢出當作已證明沒有缺陷。
把教育分類當作可執行的軍機檢修程序。
pitfallsEn: Equating nondetection with proven absence.
Treating the exercise as an executable military-aircraft maintenance procedure.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.

guides.title: 旋翼推力與反扭矩的概念平衡
guides.titleEn: Conceptual rotor thrust and reaction-torque balance
guides.concept: 旋翼盤推力、重量與機身反扭矩是不同的量。使用FAA通用直升機原理，建立沒有武器或特定機型參數的力與力矩圖。
guides.conceptEn: Rotor thrust, weight and fuselage reaction torque are distinct quantities. Use general FAA helicopter principles to draw forces and moments without weapon systems or model-specific parameters.
procedure: 畫出理想懸停示意，分別標記重力、推力與旋翼扭矩。
以符號而非真機數字檢查力平衡與力矩平衡。
比較改變總推力與改變推力方向的概念差異。
列出示意沒有涵蓋的非定常氣動、結構彈性及控制限制。
procedureEn: Draw an ideal hover and label gravity, thrust and rotor torque separately.
Use symbols rather than aircraft values to check force and moment balance.
Compare changing total thrust with changing its direction.
List omitted unsteady aerodynamics, flexibility and control limits.
evidence: 單位一致的受力與力矩示意。
對模型適用範圍的清楚說明。
evidenceEn: Force and moment diagrams with consistent units.
A clear statement of model applicability.
pitfalls: 把扭矩與升力直接相加。
把民用概念公式用作阿帕契性能改良或飛控設計。
pitfallsEn: Adding torque directly to lift.
Using the concept exercise to optimize Apache performance or flight controls.

guides.title: 把安全觀察變成可追溯的檢查紀錄
guides.titleEn: Turn safety observations into traceable inspection records
guides.concept: 本練習只建立桌面檢查紀錄格式。可見異常、原因假設與處置是三個不同欄位，不能從短片直接取得實機操作資格。
guides.conceptEn: This is a desk exercise in inspection records. Visible anomalies, causal hypotheses and disposition belong in separate fields; a short video does not qualify someone to operate an aircraft.
procedure: 選擇影片提到的一個通用安全情境，只記錄片中實際說明。
建立觀察、時間、來源、假設與待確認事項欄位。
把可直接觀察與需要合格人員判讀的項目分開。
用第二人複核紀錄是否能重現觀察，不對實機執行檢修。
procedureEn: Select one generic safety situation and record only what the video states.
Create fields for observation, time, source, hypothesis and unresolved questions.
Separate visible evidence from matters requiring qualified personnel.
Have another person reproduce the observation from the record without working on an aircraft.
evidence: 有來源時間位置的桌面紀錄表。
每項未知皆有明確待確認標記。
evidenceEn: A desk record with source time locations.
Explicit pending-verification flags for unknowns.
pitfalls: 把原因猜測寫成已確認故障。
省略影片未涵蓋事項而假裝完整檢查單。
pitfallsEn: Recording guesses as confirmed causes.
Presenting incomplete video notes as a complete checklist.

guides.title: 外部水壓：從符號模型到驗證證據
guides.titleEn: External water pressure: from symbolic model to evidence
guides.concept: 靜水壓概念可寫為p=p0+ρgh，但這不是耐壓殼安全公式。WHOI的Alvin改建報導顯示壓力艙需經專業試驗；本練習不設計可載人的殼體。
guides.conceptEn: Hydrostatic pressure can be modeled as p=p0+ρgh, but that is not a pressure-hull safety formula. WHOI documents professional pressure testing during Alvin upgrades; this exercise does not design a crewed hull.
procedure: 用示意圖定義水面基準、深度與內外壓力。
在假設密度固定的符號模型中比較兩個深度，不代入實際潛艦規格。
說明壓力荷載、材料強度與結構失穩為何不能互相替代。
讀取WHOI公開試驗敘述，列出仍未知的設計與認證資料。
procedureEn: Define the surface datum, depth and internal/external pressure schematically.
Compare two depths symbolically at assumed constant density, without naval specifications.
Explain why pressure load, material strength and instability are different questions.
Read the public WHOI test account and list design or certification evidence still unknown.
evidence: 有假設與單位的壓力示意。
公開證據與未知項目的分列表。
evidenceEn: A pressure schematic with assumptions and units.
Separate lists of public evidence and unknowns.
pitfalls: 由工作深度反推殼厚或宣稱可安全載人。
把單次壓力測試當作無限壽命證明。
pitfallsEn: Inferring hull thickness from depth or claiming crewed safety.
Treating one pressure test as proof of unlimited life.

guides.title: 科學水下載具的功能介面表
guides.titleEn: Functional interfaces of a scientific submersible
guides.concept: 科學潛器把人員艙、浮力、推進、感測與採樣系統整合起來。介面表可幫助理解能量、資料與機械支承，不涉及軍事任務系統。
guides.conceptEn: A scientific submersible integrates occupied space, buoyancy, motion, sensors and sampling. Interface tables reveal energy, data and mechanical support without military mission systems.
procedure: 依Alvin官方功能頁畫原創方塊圖，不抄繪耐壓結構。
為攝影、採樣與觀測模組各列輸入、輸出和支承需求。
選一項假想感測故障，描述它影響哪些科學資料品質。
把可由公開資料支持的功能與自行假設的連線分色。
procedureEn: Draw an original functional diagram from Alvin information, without pressure-hull drawings.
List inputs, outputs and support for imaging, sampling and observation.
Choose a hypothetical sensor fault and describe its scientific-data impact.
Distinguish publicly supported functions from assumed connections.
evidence: 至少三個模組的介面表。
標示資料來源或假設的功能圖。
evidenceEn: An interface table for at least three modules.
A functional diagram marking sources or assumptions.
pitfalls: 把示意線路畫成聲稱真實的艙內配置。
從民用感測器推演軍事偵測或隱蔽操作。
pitfallsEn: Presenting schematic links as actual internal layout.
Extending civilian sensing to military detection or stealth operations.

guides.title: 用授權決策表理解零信任
guides.titleEn: Understand zero trust through an authorization table
guides.concept: NIST將政策引擎、政策管理與執行點分成邏輯角色。教學重點是每個資源請求的明確授權與撤銷，不是把VPN改名。
guides.conceptEn: NIST separates policy engine, administration and enforcement as logical roles. The exercise focuses on explicit resource authorization and revocation, not renaming a VPN.
procedure: 用虛構使用者、裝置與文件建立小型資源清單，不使用真實憑證。
寫出身分、角色、裝置狀態與資源敏感度的判定欄位。
為允許、拒絕和撤銷各做一個紙上案例，標出PE、PA與PEP的角色。
記錄決策理由與事件ID，確認無權限者不能僅因在內網而通過。
procedureEn: Create fictional users, devices and documents without real credentials.
Define identity, role, device posture and resource sensitivity fields.
Work one allow, deny and revoke case on paper, identifying PE, PA and PEP roles.
Record reasons and event IDs; network location alone must not authorize access.
evidence: 三種決策的輸入、輸出與理由表。
可指出每個執行點保護的資源。
evidenceEn: Input, output and reasoning for three decisions.
An identified protected resource for each enforcement point.
pitfalls: 把認證成功等同於全部資源授權。
將教學模型直接部署到未授權網路。
pitfallsEn: Equating authentication with universal authorization.
Deploying the teaching model into an unauthorized network.

guides.title: 以恢復演練驗證備份
guides.titleEn: Validate backups through a restore exercise
guides.concept: 備份完成訊息不等於可恢復。以無敏感資料的獨立測試資料夾，驗證完整性、復原順序與負責人，呼應CSF 2.0 Recover。
guides.conceptEn: A successful backup message does not prove recoverability. Use an isolated folder of nonsensitive test files to verify integrity, restoration order and ownership, consistent with CSF 2.0 Recover.
procedure: 先建立可重新產生的假資料與預期檔案清單。
在獨立測試位置恢復副本，保留原始檔，不覆寫正式資料。
比較檔名、雜湊及必要開啟測試；有差異就記錄原因。
記錄恢復所需時間、缺少的權限或金鑰，以及下一次改善項目。
procedureEn: Create reproducible dummy files and an expected inventory.
Restore to an isolated location, preserving originals and production data.
Compare names, hashes and required open tests; record discrepancies.
Record elapsed recovery time, missing permissions or keys, and improvements.
evidence: 可重跑的假資料清單與比對結果。
含責任人與未決事項的演練紀錄。
evidenceEn: A reproducible dummy-data inventory and comparison.
An exercise record with ownership and unresolved issues.
pitfalls: 在正式資料上做破壞性測試。
只驗檔案存在而未驗內容完整。
pitfallsEn: Performing destructive tests on production data.
Checking existence without content integrity.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。

guides.titleEn: Body joining: locating and dimensional traceability
guides.concept: 車門間隙與外板位置受前段定位、接合及活動件調整共同影響。這是公差鏈的概念練習，不重建Ferrari治具或使用其產品尺寸。
guides.conceptEn: Door gaps and panel position reflect locating, joining and moving-part adjustment. This is a tolerance-chain exercise, not a reconstruction of Ferrari fixtures or product dimensions.
procedure: 畫出車身開口與車門的簡化輪廓，指定共同基準。
用符號誤差表示治具定位、接合變形與裝配調整。
比較一致偏移和局部變形對四周間隙的不同影響。
製作量測點表，說明為何只看一個間隙不足以定位原因。
procedureEn: Draw a simplified body opening and door with shared datums.
Represent fixture error, joining deformation and adjustment symbolically.
Compare uniform displacement with local deformation around the opening.
Create a measurement-point table and explain why one gap cannot locate a cause.
evidence: 有基準、方向與量測點的原創示意。
能區分整體偏移與局部形變的判讀。
evidenceEn: An original schematic with datums, directions and measurement points.
A diagnosis separating rigid shift from local deformation.
pitfalls: 把外觀合格等同於接頭強度合格。
將來源文章特定車型數值當通用放行標準。
pitfallsEn: Equating cosmetic acceptance with joint strength.
Applying an article’s model-specific dimensions as universal limits.

guides.title: 從鑄造到整車的交接證據
guides.titleEn: Handoff evidence from casting to vehicle assembly
guides.concept: Ferrari的2022永續報告介紹鑄造、機加工、塗裝與總裝等生產功能。可據此練習每個工站必須交出什麼證據，不能當作當前所有車型流程。
guides.conceptEn: Ferrari’s 2022 report outlines functions including casting, machining, painting and assembly. Use them to study handoff evidence, not to claim the current route of every model.
procedure: 依報告畫出功能流程，註明資料年份。
挑選一個自創的非產品專屬零件，列出毛坯、加工與檢查介面。
為每個交接點指定尺寸、表面或追溯證據之一。
加入一個假想不合格案例，畫出隔離與原因回查，而不是任意返工。
procedureEn: Map production functions and label the report year.
Choose a fictional generic part and define blank, machining and inspection interfaces.
Assign dimensional, surface or traceability evidence to each handoff.
Add one hypothetical nonconformance with quarantine and investigation rather than arbitrary rework.
evidence: 帶年份與假設標籤的工站圖。
每個交接點都有明確輸入輸出。
evidenceEn: A station map labeled with year and assumptions.
Explicit input and output at each handoff.
pitfalls: 把不同世代車型的流程拼成一條實際產線。
缺乏資料仍自行填入加工公差。
pitfallsEn: Combining vehicle generations into a claimed actual line.
Inventing machining tolerances when evidence is absent.

guides.titleEn: Build material-flow and takt hypotheses from factory visuals
guides.concept: 短片可支持工站與搬運方式的觀察，不能可靠量得實際產能。把可見事實與教學假設分開，才能用來理解瓶頸。
guides.conceptEn: A short film supports observation of stations and handling, not reliable throughput measurement. Separate visible facts from teaching assumptions before reasoning about bottlenecks.
procedure: 從影片選三個可辨識工站，以自己的文字記錄畫面。
畫出物料流與人員活動區，不臆測封閉區域。
自行設定明確標示為假設的三站週期，用最慢站討論理想瓶頸。
加入停機或重工的概念影響，說明為何影片剪輯長度不能當週期時間。
procedureEn: Choose three identifiable stations and describe visible evidence in your own words.
Map material flow and human areas without guessing hidden regions.
Assign explicitly hypothetical cycle times and discuss the slowest ideal station.
Discuss downtime or rework and explain why shot duration is not cycle time.
evidence: 事實與假設分欄的流程圖。
可重算的假設節拍表，未宣稱Tesla實測產能。
evidenceEn: A flow map separating observation and assumption.
A reproducible hypothetical timing table, not measured Tesla capacity.
pitfalls: 用快轉或剪輯片段推導真實UPH。
把一座工廠畫面套用所有車型及工廠。

guides.title: 電池熱管理：散熱、均溫與故障隔離
guides.titleEn: Battery thermal management: cooling, uniformity and isolation
guides.concept: 電池熱管理同時關注溫度、溫差與異常傳播。Tesla的公開說明描述分層設計；本練習只用低風險的符號熱網路，不拆電池或進行失效試驗。
guides.conceptEn: Battery thermal management concerns temperature, gradients and fault propagation. Tesla describes layered design publicly; this exercise uses symbolic thermal networks without dismantling packs or inducing failures.
procedure: 畫出電芯、介面、冷卻端的R-C概念網路。
以自定但清楚標示的假設比較單顆高溫與全包均溫。
把主動冷卻、溫度偵測與被動隔離分成不同功能。
列出真實驗證仍需的材料、邊界條件與感測位置，未知不自行補值。
procedureEn: Draw an R-C concept network for cells, interfaces and cooling.
Use clearly labeled assumptions to compare one hot cell with pack-wide uniformity.
Separate active cooling, sensing and passive isolation functions.
List material data, boundaries and sensor locations needed for real validation; leave unknowns unresolved.
evidence: 功能分明的熱網路與假設表。
能說明平均溫度不足以代表局部安全。
evidenceEn: A thermal network and explicit assumptions.
An explanation of why average temperature cannot establish local safety.
pitfalls: 把概念計算當作電池包安全認證。
對真實電芯短路、穿刺或拆解。
pitfallsEn: Treating a concept calculation as battery-pack certification.
Shorting, puncturing or disassembling real cells.

guides.title: 低軌網路的資料路徑與子系統
guides.titleEn: Data paths and subsystems of a low-orbit network
guides.concept: 使用者無線鏈路、衛星間光鏈路與地面網路是不同介面。Starlink官方技術頁可支援功能分類，但不同代衛星的數量及性能不能混用。
guides.conceptEn: User radio links, optical intersatellite links and ground networking are distinct interfaces. Starlink’s technology page supports functional classification, but hardware generations must not be mixed.
procedure: 畫出終端、衛星、地面接入與網際網路的概念路徑。
為光鏈路與無線鏈路使用不同線型，將可選路徑標示為概念。
另外畫電力、姿態與通訊載荷的功能關係，不加入衛星建造參數。
將每項硬體主張標註來源日期與世代；無世代資訊就不填精確數量。
procedureEn: Draw a conceptual path through terminal, satellite, ground access and internet.
Distinguish optical and radio links and label optional paths conceptual.
Map power, attitude and communication-payload functions without build parameters.
Label hardware claims by source date and generation; omit exact counts when generation is unclear.
evidence: 兩種鏈路與各介面的功能表。
沒有把不同衛星世代數據合併的來源紀錄。
evidenceEn: A functional table of links and interfaces.
A source record that keeps satellite generations separate.
pitfalls: 把軌道高度直接當完整連線延遲。
把所有資料流都假定經同一種鏈路。
pitfallsEn: Equating orbital altitude with complete network latency.
Assuming all traffic takes the same link type.

guides.title: 安全地點的天空遮擋評估
guides.titleEn: Assess sky obstruction from a safe location
guides.concept: 移動中的低軌衛星需要合適天空視野。遮擋評估與通訊故障診斷不同；本練習使用地面安全位置或自備示意，沒有高處安裝要求。
guides.conceptEn: Moving low-orbit satellites need suitable sky visibility. Obstruction assessment differs from diagnosing every network fault. Use safe ground-level locations or your own diagram, with no elevated installation required.
procedure: 依官方支援頁辨識遮蔽物類型與終端視野。
若已有相容裝置，在安全地面位置依官方App指引比較候選地點；否則畫示意。
記錄同一視角下的樹木、屋簷與其他遮擋，避免以手機位置替代不同終端位置。
把遮擋發現與網路擁塞、供電或線材問題分開，不把所有中斷歸同一原因。
procedureEn: Identify obstruction types and terminal field of view from official support.
If a compatible setup is available, compare safe ground-level sites using the official app; otherwise draw a diagram.
Record trees, eaves and obstructions from a consistent viewpoint.
Separate obstruction findings from congestion, power or cable issues rather than assigning one cause to every interruption.
evidence: 候選位置與一致觀察條件的紀錄。
可區分遮擋與其他故障假設的比較表。
evidenceEn: Records of candidate locations and consistent observation conditions.
A comparison separating obstruction from other fault hypotheses.
pitfalls: 假定任何地區均已提供相同服務。
為了取得視野自行攀爬或改裝天線。
pitfallsEn: Assuming identical service availability everywhere.
Climbing or modifying antennas merely to obtain a view.
guides.sourceScope: 來源支持公開背景或原理；以下步驟與驗收是原創教學推演，不是原廠SOP。使用自行繪製的示意或自行取得的合法資料，未附實測數據。
guides.sourceScopeEn: The source supports public context or principles. Procedures and checks are original educational exercises, not a manufacturer SOP. Use self-drawn models or lawfully obtained evidence; no measured dataset is bundled.
